result.topic_en: Calculations on an orbit perturbed by a ring of matter on an inclined circle, giving the equation for 1/ρ as a function of the angle φ and reducing the resulting integrals to complete elliptic integrals K(m,n), with derivative relations in m and n.
result.transcription:
$\rho^2 \frac{d\varphi}{dt} =$
$\frac{1}{\rho} = \beta \cos(\varphi - \Pi) + \frac{1}{p \cos i} \sqrt{1 - \sin i^2 \cos(\varphi - \Omega)^2}$
$\frac{d^2 \frac{1}{\rho}}{d\varphi^2} + \frac{1}{\rho} = \int_{\alpha}^{\pi+\alpha} \frac{c}{\sqrt{(1 - \sin i^2 \cos(\varphi - \Omega)^2)^3}}$
$\frac{c}{\pi} \int_0^{\pi} \frac{\cos 2\varphi \, d\varphi}{\sqrt{(1 - \sin i^2 \sin \varphi^2)^3}}$ $\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{d\varphi}{\sqrt{1 - \sin i^2 \sin \varphi^2}} = \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{d\varphi}{\sqrt{m^2 \cos \varphi^2 + n^2 \sin \varphi^2}}$
$\frac{1}{m} \cdot \frac{dK}{dm} + \frac{1}{n} \frac{dK}{dn}$
$\left(\frac{1}{m} \frac{dK}{dm} - \frac{1}{n} \frac{dK}{dn}\right) \cos 2\Omega$
$\left(\frac{1}{n} \frac{dK}{dm} - \frac{1}{m}[?] \frac{dK}{dn}\right) \sin 2\Omega$
$m \cdot \frac{dK}{dm} + n \frac{dK}{dn} = -K$

methods.what: Areal velocity (angular momentum) expression for orbital motion
Orbit equation for the reciprocal radius as a function of the polar angle
Binet-type differential equation for 1/ρ with an integral forcing term
Fourier (cos 2φ) coefficient of the forcing term as an integral
Complete elliptic integral of the first kind written in symmetric m,n form
Expressing coefficients through derivatives of K with respect to m and n, with cos 2Ω and sin 2Ω dependence
Euler homogeneity relation for K (homogeneous of degree −1 in m,n)
